metadata.description: luna-brain — OSS Obsidian vault skeleton for Claude Code workflows. This marketplace ships NO plugins: Steph Ango's obsidian skill pack installs from its own upstream marketplace (obsidian@obsidian-skills), because its author publishes no release tags and a plugin pinned to a bare commit cannot be installed; claude-obsidian ships via the himmel marketplace; pair with obsidian-second-brain (installed via its upstream install.sh) for PARA capture skills. metadata.version below is the template version read by scripts/upgrade.sh.
